english: Lifting yam vines off the ground using stakes allows the leaves to spread out and capture maximum sunlight. Sunlight helps the leaves produce energy, which goes directly into expanding the size of the underground tuber.
ga: Kɛ́ akɛ tsei tsu nii kɛwo sweet potato wain tsei lɛ anɔ kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ, ehaa tsei lɛ ahe tsei lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa ni amɛnáa hulu la babaoo bɔ ni eeenyɛ. Hulu la yeɔ ebuaa baai lɛ ni amɛjieɔ hewalɛ ni haa shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ daraa tɛ̃ɛ.

english: It is safer to wait until the rainy season fully settles. The first rain is often followed by a long dry spell, which can cause freshly germinated seeds to dry out and die in the hot soil before the next rain comes.
ga: Eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ ooomɛ kɛyashi nugbɔshiimɔ be lɛ mli aba shi kwraa. Bei pii lɛ, nugbɔshiimɔ be kakadaŋŋ nyiɛɔ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ lɛ sɛɛ. Enɛ baanyɛ aha dumɔwui ni ekwɛ̃ ehee lɛ agbi ni amɛgboi yɛ sũ ni mli edɔ lɛ mli dani nugbɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ aba.

english: Why are the leaves on my young cocoa plants turning yellow and getting scorched by the sun?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-cacao tsei bibii lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ ni hulu lɛ miitso lɛ?

english: Young cocoa trees are delicate and burn easily in direct sunlight. Planting plantains or shade trees nearby acts like a natural umbrella, keeping the cocoa cool and moist until it grows older.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ ahe waaa, ni kɛ́ hulu lɛ tso amɛ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ, amɛshãa oya. Tsei bibii loo tsei ni haa hulutsoo ni bɛŋkɛ lɛ ni aduɔ Amɛfeɔ ekome tamɔ adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔlɔ. Enɛ haa kookoo lɛ mli jɔɔ ni edɔɔ kɛyashiɔ be mli ni edaa.

english: Why are the leaves on my maize crop turning yellow starting from the bottom tip?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi ŋmãa tsei lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛmiijɛ shishigbɛ ŋmeii lɛ ahe lɛ?

english: Yellowing maize leaves are usually a signal that the crop lacks nitrogen, an essential soil food. Adding compost or nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps green up the leaves so the plants can grow strong ears of corn.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, abɛi baa ŋmɔŋ ji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ bɛ nitrogen, ni ji shikpɔŋ mli niyenii ni he hia. Kɛ́ okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen eyi mli obɔ lɛ fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebaa lɛ afee eŋɔli bɔni afee ni tso lɛ anyɛ akwɛ ŋmãa toi ni yɔɔ hewalɛ.

english: Why do my cassava tubers rot in the ground when the rains become heavy?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots cannot survive in waterlogged soil because they cannot breathe when flooded. Building soil mounds or raised ridges allows excess rainwater to drain away, keeping the tubers safe from rot.
ga: Cassava shishifãi nyɛŋ ahi shi yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ amɛnyɛŋ amɛmu kɛji nu shwie amɛnɔ. Gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ ni afee lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa. ni ehaa yitso lɛ fiteɔ.

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when they suffer from heat stress or irregular watering. Giving them steady water and mulching the soil helps keep the root zone cool so flowers can set fruit.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ́ amɛmiipiŋ yɛ hulutsoo loo nu ni akɛhaa amɛ be fɛɛ be lɛ hewɔ. Nu ni akɛhaa amɛ daa kɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa shishifã lɛ mli jɔɔ bɔni afee ni fɔfɔi lɛ awo yibii.

english: Why do other farmers tell me to plant cowpeas or groundnuts alongside my main crops?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ okwaafoi krokomɛi Ko ni amɛkɛɛ mi akɛ madu tsina loo ŋmeii yɛ miŋmɔshi nibii titri lɛ masɛi lɛ?

english: Cowpeas and groundnuts belong to the legume family, which naturally grabs nitrogen gas from the air and traps it into the soil. This enriches the soil and helps your surrounding crops grow without needing extra chemical fertilizer.
ga: Cowpeas kɛ peanuts ji legume weku lɛ mli bii ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛmɔɔ nitrogen gas kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛŋmɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ nii jogbaŋŋ, ni eyeɔ ebuaa ŋmɔshi nibii ni ebɔle amɛhe lɛ hu. Ekwɛ̃ɔ ni tsofai krokomɛi ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ he ehiaaa.

english: Leaf curling in peppers is usually caused by tiny insects like thrips or mites sucking the juices from the leaves. Spraying early with neem water or insecticidal soap helps clear the insects and protects leaf growth.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ thrips loo mites ni nuɔ nu ni jɛɔ baai lɛ amli lɛ ji nɔ ni haa chili baai lɛ shwieɔ shi. Neem nu loo samla ni gbeɔ kooloi ni akɛshwieɔ nɔ mra Ebaaye ebua ni ejie kooloi kɛjɛ mli ni ebaatsi baai lɛ adalɛ naa.

english: Why do I need to clear tall bushes and put up wooden sticks for my yam vines to climb?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ majie tsei bibii ni kɛlɛ lɛ ni mato tsei aniji koni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ akwɔ lɛ?

english: Yam vines need to spread their leaves high up in the sunlight to collect energy. Staking the vines off the ground helps the leaves capture maximum light, which fuels the growth of big, healthy tubers underground.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ agbɛ amɛbaai lɛ ashwã ŋwɛi shɔɔŋ yɛ hulu la lɛ mli koni amɛbua hewalɛ naa. Wein tso lɛ ni aduɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ haa baai lɛ nyɛɔ amɛmɔɔ la babaoo bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ. Enɛ ji tsofa ni haa shikpɔŋ shishi tsei wuji ni he wa lɛ daa.

english: When too many shoots grow around a single plantain tree, they all fight for the same soil food and water. Removing extra shoots leaves only one or two strong stems, ensuring you get large, heavy bunches of plantain.
ga: Be mli ni ŋmeii babaoo ni miida yɛ dumɔwu kome he lɛ fa babaoo. Tsoi lɛ fɛɛ kɛ amɛhe woɔ niyenii kɛ nu he akaŋshii mli yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ. Kɛ́ ojie ŋmeii ni fa fe nine lɛ, ebaashi ŋmeii kome loo enyɔ pɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ, ni ebaaha oná ŋmeii agbo ni tsii.

english: Why are my maize seeds taking so long to sprout after I buried them deep into the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele dumɔwui lɛ heɔ be babaoo dani amɛkwɛ̃ɔ beni afu amɛ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ mli shɔŋŋ lɛ?

english: Planting seeds too deep exhausts their stored energy before they can reach the surface to see sunlight. Maize seeds should only be buried a few centimeters deep so they can easily shoot up through the topsoil.
ga: Dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ mli tsɔ lɛ baafite hewalɛ ni amɛto lɛ dani amɛyashɛ ŋshɔ lɛ hiɛ koni amɛna hulu la. Esa akɛ afu ŋmãa dumɔwui lɛ mli sɛntimitai fioo pɛ bɔni afee ni amɛtsɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ amɛkwɛ̃ oya.

english: Why does leaving weeds near my crop stems make my vegetables grow so thin and weak?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi ni mishiɔ yɛ tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ haa mi-aduawai lɛ feɔ mlɛo waa ni amɛhe waaa lɛ?

english: Weeds are aggressive plants that steal water, soil nutrients, and light away from your crops. Clearing weeds early ensures your crops get all the food they need to grow thick and healthy.
ga: Jwɛi ji tsei ni yɔɔ basabasa ni juɔ nu. niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ la ni jɛɔ onibii amli Jwɛi ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ mli mra Ehaa onibii lɛ niyenii ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛdara ni amɛná hewalɛ.

english: Yellow leaves at the bottom of maize plants usually mean the crop is lacking nitrogen, which is an essential nutrient for leafy growth. Adding nitrogen-rich fertilizer or compost helps keep the leaves green so the ears can grow big and heavy.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa tsei ashishi lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli. ni ji niyenii ni he hiaa kɛha baai lɛ adalɛ Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baai lɛ ahi shi eŋɔli. Toi lɛ baafee wuji ni amɛhe wa.

english: Why does my cassava produce huge stems and leaves above ground, but very small tubers under the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava lɛ yɛ ŋmeii kɛ baai wuji ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ? Shi ani yitso bibioo ko yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi?

english: When soil has too much nitrogen or gets excess water, the cassava plant puts all its energy into growing leaves instead of feeding the roots. Reducing nitrogen fertilizer and encouraging root growth yields larger tubers.
ga: Beni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nitrogen loo nu babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ Cassava tso lɛ kudɔɔ ehewalɛ fɛɛ kɛyaa baai ni miida lɛ anɔ moŋ fe ni eeeha shishifãi lɛ niyenii. Nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ nɔtsemɔ kɛ shishifãi ni yaa hiɛ lɛ baaha ŋmeii wuji aba.

english: This is black pod disease, caused by a fungus that spreads quickly in cool, wet, and shady conditions. Pruning excess tree branches allows sunlight and air flow to dry out the farm, which stops the fungus from spreading.
ga: Enɛ ji black pod hela. Gbɔmɔtso ko ni gbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni mli ejɔ, fɔ́, kɛ hulutsoo kɛbaa. Niji ni fa fe nine lɛ ni afoɔ lɛ haa hulu la kɛ kɔɔyɔɔ tsɔɔ mli koni ŋmɔji lɛ amli agbi. Enɛ baakpa tsɛŋemɔ hela lɛ gbɛfaŋnɔ.

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants curling upwards and stopping the plant from producing flowers?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miibɔle amɛhe ni amɛmiikpa tso lɛ fɔmɔ lɛ?

english: Leaf curling in pepper plants is usually caused by tiny insects like aphids or thrips sucking sap from the leaves. Spraying the leaves with neem oil solution or insecticidal soap helps clear the pests so the plant can grow properly.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ aphids loo thrips ni nuɔ baai lɛ amli nu lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni shwieɔ shi yɛ pepper tsei anɔ lɛ baa. Kɛ́ okɛ neem fɔ loo samla ni gbeɔ kooloi lɛ shwie baai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ejie kooloi ni gbeɔ kooloi lɛ koni tso lɛ anyɛ ada jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why are there small caterpillars hiding inside the central funnels of my young maize plants eating the leaves?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii yɔɔ lɛ? Ani mikɛ mihe ewo mi ŋmãa tsei bibii lɛ ateŋ gbɛjegbɛ lɛ mli ni miiye baai?

english: These are Fall Armyworms, a common pest in Ghana that targets young corn. Applying approved bio-pesticides or neem extracts directly into the plant funnel early in the morning destroys the worms before they destroy the growing tip.
ga: Enɛɛmɛi ji Fall Armyworms, ni ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni afɔɔ namɔ yɛ Ghana ni gbeɔ ŋmãa bibii lɛ. Kɛ́ akɛ tsofa ni gbeɔ kooloi loo neem mli nu ni akpɛlɛ nɔ lɛ wo ŋmeii ni aduɔ lɛ amli tɛ̃ɛ leebi maŋkpa lɛ, ebaakpata ŋmeii lɛ ahiɛ dani amɛbaakpãtã ŋmeii lɛ ashishifãi ni miida lɛ ahiɛ.

english: Why do yellow flowers appear on my groundnut plants above ground if the nuts actually grow under the soil?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔii ni tsuɔ tamɔ ŋmɔtɔ miije kpo yɛ mi-peanut tsei ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ? Akɛni ŋmeii lɛ kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi diɛŋtsɛ hewɔ lɛ?

english: After groundnut flowers are pollinated, the plant grows long stems called 'pegs' that bend down and push themselves into the soil. The actual groundnuts then form and mature underground at the tips of these pegs.
ga: Beni amɛwoɔ ŋmei fɔfɔi lɛ amli pollen sɛɛ lɛ Tsei lɛ yɛ ŋmeii kakadaji ni atsɛɔ amɛ ‘pegs’ ni shwieɔ amɛhe ni amɛtsiɔ amɛhe kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Peanuts diɛŋtsɛ feɔ ni amɛdaraa yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi yɛ nɛkɛ ŋmeii nɛɛ anaagbee.

english: Yam vines need to reach up high so their leaves can trap maximum sunlight to produce food for the underground tuber. Staking also lifts the leaves off the damp soil, protecting them from soil-borne diseases.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ afee shɔŋŋ bɔni afee ni amɛbaai lɛ anyɛ amɔmɔ hulu la babaoo bɔ ni amɛaanyɛ koni amɛha niyenii aha ŋmeii lɛ. Staking hu yeɔ ebuaa ni ewoɔ baai kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ ni mli efɔ nɔ. Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ebuɔ amɛhe kɛjɛɔ helai ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ lɛ ahe.

english: Why does flooded water help swamp rice grow well while it drowns other crops like maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ nu afua yeɔ ebuaa ni sũ lɛ daa jogbaŋŋ yɛ be mli ni ehaa ŋmɔshi nibii krokomɛi tamɔ ŋmãa lɛ nu afua lɛ?

english: Swamp rice has special internal air channels in its stems that transport oxygen from the air down to its roots underwater. Crops like maize lack these channels, so their roots suffocate and rot when submerged.
ga: Swamp ŋmãa yɛ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ŋtayaai krɛdɛɛi yɛ eshishifãi lɛ amli ni ekɛ kɔɔyɔɔ ni haa wala yibii lɛ jɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli kɛyaa nu shishi shishifãi lɛ amli. Nibii ni aduɔ tamɔ ŋmãa bɛ gbɛi nɛɛ. No hewɔ lɛ, amɛshishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛgboiɔ kɛ́ awo amɛ nu mli.

english: Why do the bottoms of my green tomatoes turn black and rotten while still hanging on the plant?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato eŋɔli lɛ shishi miitsɔ ediŋŋ ni egboɔ yɛ be mli ni ekã tso lɛ nɔ lolo lɛ?

english: This black patch is called blossom-end rot. It happens when the plant cannot absorb enough calcium, usually caused by inconsistent watering where the soil gets very dry and then suddenly flooded.
ga: Atsɛɔ nɛkɛ fã diŋ nɛɛ akɛ blossom end rot. Ebaa kɛji tsei nyɛɛɛ aŋɔ calcium ni fa bɔ ni sa. Bei pii lɛ, nu ni akɛwoɔ mɔ mli ni ejaaa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ enɛ baa. Kɛtsɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ ni ehaa egbiɔ waa ni ekɛ nu afua baa lɛ nɔ.

english: Leaving too many young shoots (suckers) forces them to compete with the main plantain tree for water, nutrients, and sunlight. Pruning them leaves only one or two strong suckers, ensuring the main tree bears large bunches.
ga: Nibii bibii babaoo ni ashiɔ (ŋmeii) lɛ nyɛɔ amɛnɔ koni amɛkɛ dumɔwu titri lɛ abɔ akaŋ kɛha nu, niyenii kɛ hulu la. Kɛ́ afolɔ tsei lɛ, tso kome loo enyɔ pɛ baajɛ mli aba ni yɔɔ hewalɛ. Enɛ baaha tso titri lɛ aná kuu agbo.

english: Why do my cocoa pods turn black and dry up on the tree before they are ready for harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo ŋmɔji lɛ feɔ ediŋŋ ni amɛgbiɔ yɛ tso lɛ nɔ dani amɛfeɔ klalo kɛha kpamɔɔ lɛ?

english: This is caused by a fungal infection called Black Pod disease. It spreads rapidly in high humidity, heavy rain, and overly shaded farms, causing the pods to rot from the outside in.
ga: Fungal hela ko ni atsɛɔ lɛ black pod hela kɛ enɛ baa. Egbɛɔ eshwaa oya yɛ hei ni hulutsoo be babaoo yɔɔ, nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa kɛ ŋmɔji ni hulutsoo be babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ amli. Enɛ haa ŋmeii lɛ fiteɔ kɛjɛɔ kponɔgbɛ kɛboteɔ mli.

english: Your cassava plant likely has Cassava Mosaic Disease, which is spread by tiny insects called whiteflies. It prevents the plant from making enough food, resulting in smaller cassava roots.
ga: Ekolɛ o-cassava tso lɛ yɛ cassava mosaic hela. ni kooloi bibii ni atsɛɔ amɛ whitefly lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa lɛ Etsiɔ tsei anaa koni amɛkafee niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, ŋmei shishifãi lɛ feɔ bibii.

english: Why do the leaves of my pepper plants shrink, twist, and bunch together at the top?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miigbɔjɔ, amɛmiibɔle amɛhe, ni amɛmiibua amɛhe naa yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ lɛ?

english: This leaf curling is caused by tiny pests like mites or thrips sucking the sap out of young leaves, or by a plant virus. It stops the plant from growing and producing new peppers.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ baa lɛ shwieɔ shi nɛɛ ji kooloi bibii tamɔ ŋmeii loo thrips ni nuɔ baa bibii lɛ amli nu lɛ. loo kɛjɛ tso mli helai ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ mli Ehaa tso lɛ daa ni ekɛ ŋmeii heei baa.

english: Yellow leaves at the bottom of a maize plant mean the soil lacks nitrogen. The plant is moving its limited nitrogen upward to feed its newest growth, leaving the older leaf starving.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa tsei ashishi lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Tsei miitsi nitrogen fioo ko kɛmiiya ŋwɛi koni amɛkɛha tsei ni eda fe fɛɛ lɛ niyenii. Shi baai momo lɛ hɔmɔ

english: Why does planting cowpea or groundnuts on my farm make my next maize crop grow better?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tsina loo ŋmeii ni miduɔ yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ baaha mi-ŋmei ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ akwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ lɛ?

english: Legumes like cowpeas and groundnuts have special bacteria in their roots that pull nitrogen from the air and feed it to the soil, creating natural fertilizer for future crops.
ga: Legumes tamɔ cowpeas kɛ peanuts yɛ bacteria krɛdɛɛ ko yɛ amɛshishifãi amli. Enɛ gbalaa nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii baa kɛha wɔsɛɛ ŋmɔshi nibii.

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when temperatures get too high or when there is sudden water stress. The plant sheds its blossoms to save energy and protect itself from drying out.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ baashwie amɛfɔfɔi lɛ anɔ kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ tee hiɛ tsɔ loo kɛ́ amɛna nu he haomɔ trukaa. Tsei fɔɔ fɔfɔi koni amɛkɛbu hewalɛ he ni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ ŋmɔlɔ he.

english: Why do my yam tubers grow thin, crooked, and hard instead of soft and smooth?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi sweet potato ŋmɔji lɛ amli tsei, ebɔle, ni amɛhe wa moŋ fe ni amɛbaafee blɛoo ni amɛfee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ lɛ?

english: Yams become thin and bent when the soil beneath them is too hard or stony for the tuber to expand, or when microscopic worms called nematodes attack the growing tip of the yam.
ga: Sweet potatoes lɛ feɔ mlɛo ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ kɛ́ shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ amɛshishi lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo eyɛ tɛi tsɔ ni ŋmeii lɛ nyɛŋ agbɛ ashwã. aloo beni ŋmeii bibii ni atsɛɔ amɛ nematodes lɛ tutua ŋmeii ni miida lɛ ashishifãi lɛ.

english: Why do my plantain trees snap or fall over at the stem even when there is no strong wind?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi plantain lɛ fãa loo egbeeɔ tso lɛ shishi lɛ? He ni kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa bɛ lɛ?

english: Weevils or small root worms often burrow inside the base and roots of the plantain, eating it empty from the inside until the trunk can no longer support the weight of the leaves and fruit.
ga: Moth loo shishifã bibioo Bei pii lɛ, efoɔ kɛboteɔ plantain tsei lɛ ashishi kɛ amɛshishifãi amli. Kɛtsɔ eyeli ni ayeɔ lɛ nɔ Kɛjɛ emli kɛyashi tso lɛ shishi lɛ nyɛŋ akwɛ baai kɛ aduawai lɛ agbɔjɔmɔ lɛ nɔ dɔŋŋ.

english: Why do my rice leaves turn yellow and dry up very fast if rainwater leaves the field for just a few days?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbiɔ oya kɛji nugbɔ nu shi ŋmãa ŋmɔ lɛ mli gbii fioo pɛ lɛ?

english: Rice plants have very shallow root systems that cannot reach deep groundwater, making them quickly stressed and unable to absorb soil nutrients whenever topsoil moisture disappears.
ga: Omɔ tsei yɛ shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ waa ni nyɛɛɛ ashɛ shikpɔŋ shishi nu ni mli kwɔ lɛ he. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ haoɔ oya ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛhe shikpɔŋ lɛ mli niyenii be fɛɛ be ni nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baaje mli.

english: Why are the oldest leaves on my oil palm tree turning brown and dangling downward around the trunk?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni etsɛ fe fɛɛ ni yɔɔ mi-oil palm tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni amɛmiibɔle tso lɛ shishi lɛ?

english: Oil palm trees sacrifice their lower fronds when they face drought or lack potassium. The tree deliberately dries out its older leaves to send remaining water and nutrients up to the newest fronds.
ga: Mu tsei kɛ amɛshishi baai lɛ shaa afɔle kɛ́ amɛkɛ hɔmɔ loo potassium ni faaa kpe. Tso lɛ tsɔɔ yiŋtoo ko nɔ egbiɔ ebaai ni egbɔ lɛ koni ekɛ nu kɛ niyenii ni eshwɛ lɛ amaje baai heei lɛ.

english: Why do my maize leaves roll up during the hottest part of the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane be ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Maize leaves roll up as a natural defense to trap moisture and reduce water loss under intense heat. It is a sign that the plant is under water stress and trying to protect itself from drying out.
ga: Abɛi baai lɛ shwieɔ shi koni efee adebɔɔ mli gbɛtsii nii ko ni baaha nu ni mli edɔ waa lɛ ahi shi ni ehaa nu ni laajeɔ yɛ latsaa ni naa wa mli lɛ baa shi. Eji okadi ni tsɔɔ akɛ tso lɛ yɛ nu he naagba shishi ni eebɔ mɔdɛŋ ni ebu ehe koni ekagbi.

english: Can I use water from any source to irrigate my vegetables, or can bad water ruin my crops?
ga: Ani manyɛ mikɛ nu ni jɛ he fɛɛ he lɛ afɔ mi-aduawai lɛ anɔ nu? Aloo ani nu gbonyo baanyɛ akpata midumɔ nii lɛ ahiɛ?

english: Unclean or contaminated water can introduce unwanted diseases, bacteria, or heavy salts into your farm. Clean water keeps the plant roots healthy and prevents yield loss or contaminated produce.
ga: Nu ni he tseee loo nu ni mli ewo muji baanyɛ ekɛ helai ni ataooo, helatsɛmɛi, loo ŋmeii ni tsii aba oŋmɔ lɛ mli. Nu ni mli tse wajeɔ tsei ashishifãi ni ehaaa ŋmɔshi nibii ni fiteɔ loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni mli ewo muji lɛ aya hiɛ.

english: Why do my tomato fruits turn brown and dry up on one side while still growing on the plant?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato yibii lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni amɛmiigbi yɛ fa kome be mli ni amɛmiida lolo yɛ tso lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: This is sunscorch, caused by direct heat and excessive sunlight hitting the soft fruit. Ensuring your crops have adequate leaf coverage or light shade helps protect the fruits from burning.
ga: Enɛ ji hulu la ni dɔlɛ tɛ̃ɛ kɛ hulu la ni fa fe nine ni tswaa aduawai bibii lɛ kɛbaa. Kɛ́ okwɛ koni oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ aná baai ni fa bɔ ni sa loo su ni mli tse lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu aduawai lɛ ahe kɛjɛ shãa he.

english: How can I protect my young nursery crops from being destroyed by free-roaming farm animals like chickens?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mabu midumɔwui lɛ ahe koni ŋmɔ mli kooloi ni nyiɛɔ amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛhe, tamɔ kooloi akafite amɛ?

english: Animals scratch the topsoil looking for food, which destroys tender roots. Using simple wire netting, bamboo fencing, or raised nursery beds keeps animals away from fragile young seedlings.
ga: Koolooi shwieɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ koni amɛtao niyenii. ni fiteɔ shishifãi ni yɔɔ mlɛo lɛ Kɛtsɔ waya ŋtayaa folo, ŋtayaai ahe ŋtayaai loo ŋtayaai ni awo nɔ lɛ anɔ. Ye obua ni kooloi akaje dumɔwui bibii ni waaa lɛ ahe.

english: Why do my vegetable plants grow tall and thin without bearing fruits when planted under heavy shade?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-aduawai lɛ daa ni amɛfeɔ mlɛo ni amɛwooo yibii kɛji akɛ adu amɛ yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: Crops require direct sunlight to create food for flower and fruit development. Under deep shade, plants waste energy stretching upward to reach light, making them weak and unproductive.
ga: Tsei taoɔ hulu la tɛ̃ɛ koni amɛfee niyenii kɛha fɔfɔi kɛ aduawai adalɛ. Yɛ hulutsoo be ni mli kwɔ lɛ shishi Tsei fiteɔ hewalɛ ni shwereɔ koni amɛshɛ la he. Enɛ haa tsei ni bɛ hewalɛ ni wooo yibii baa.

english: Why do my pepper plants wilt in the afternoon sun even though I watered them in the morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ shwane hulutsoo be mli eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ nu haa lɛ leebi moŋ?

english: Morning water can quickly evaporate from exposed soil under hot weather. Adding mulch, such as dry grass or leaves around the root area, traps moisture in the ground and keeps roots cool longer.
ga: Leebi nu lɛ baanyɛ atsɔ shikpɔŋ ni ajie lɛ kpo lɛ nɔ oya yɛ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli edɔ lɛ shishi. Kɛ́ okɛ jwɛi ni egbi loo baai wo shishifãi lɛ ahe lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ŋmɔtɔ ahi shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni ebaaha shishifãi lɛ afee fɛ̃i be kakadaŋŋ.

english: Is it safe to put chemical fertilizer on my crops when the sun is very strong and the ground is dry?
ga: Ani eyɛ shweshweeshwe akɛ mikɛ tsofai ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔshi nibii amli lɛ baawo miŋmɔshi nibii amli kɛ́ hulu lɛ miitswa waa ni shikpɔŋ lɛ hu egbi?

english: Applying dry fertilizer without enough soil moisture can scorch and burn plant roots. Fertilizer needs water to dissolve properly so plant roots can absorb it safely.
ga: Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbi wo mli ni shikpɔŋ lɛ mli nu ni fa bɔ ni sa bɛ mli lɛ, ebaanyɛ eha tsei lɛ ashishifãi lɛ ashã ni amɛshã. Nu he miihia ni ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ atsɔ mli jogbaŋŋ bɔni afee ni tsei shishifãi lɛ anyɛ aŋɔ amɛ shweshweeshwe.

english: Why do my transplanted crop seedlings dry up and die when I plant them out in the afternoon?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni midu lɛ gbɛ́ɔ ni amɛgboiɔ kɛ́ midu amɛ shwane mli lɛ?

english: Young transplants lose water rapidly under intense sun before their roots can establish. It is best to transplant late in the evening or on cloudy days to give them time to recover overnight.
ga: Tsei bibii lɛ laajeɔ nu oya yɛ hulu la ni naa wa shishi dani amɛshishifãi lɛ jeɔ shishi. Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ ooodu gbɛkɛ loo yɛ gbi ni atatu yɔɔ nɔ lɛ nɔ koni eha be aba ni ekɛ ehe awo mli nyɔɔŋ kome mli.

english: Why are the blossoms on my garden plants falling off before turning into fruits during hot spells?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔi ni yɔɔ tsei ni yɔɔ mibɔɔ lɛ mli lɛ anɔ lɛ shwieɔ shi dani amɛfeɔ aduawai yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: High temperatures and heat stress cause plants to drop flowers to conserve energy and water. Keeping the root zone moist helps plants retain their flowers and form fruits.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni mli wa kɛ dɔlɛ mli haomɔ haa tsei shwieɔ fɔfɔi koni amɛkɛbu hewalɛ kɛ nu he. Kɛ́ tso lɛ shishifã lɛ mli fɔ́ lɛ, ebaaye ebua tso lɛ ni ekwɛ fɔfɔi anɔ ni ewo yibii.

english: Why do spots appear on my crop leaves after rain followed by strong sunshine?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii jeɔ kpo yɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ahe baai anɔ yɛ nugbɔ ni enɛ sɛɛ ni hulu la ni tsoɔ waa nyiɛɔ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Water droplets left on leaves act like small magnifying lenses under intense sun, causing light burns. Combined with high heat and moisture, this also creates an ideal environment for leaf diseases to start.
ga: Nu ni shwieɔ shi yɛ baai lɛ anɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii tamɔ ŋmɛlɛ bibii ni haa nɔ ko feɔ bibioo. hulu la ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi lɛ kɛ la baa Kɛji akɛ akɛ dɔlɛ ni mli wa kɛ hulutsoo be fata he lɛ Ehaa shihilɛ ni hi jogbaŋŋ hu baa kɛha tsei amli helai ni baa lɛ shishijee.

english: How do I know which type of rice seed is best to plant on my farm?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male ŋmãa ni hi jogbaŋŋ ni esa akɛ madu yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli?

english: Different rice varieties perform differently depending on your soil, water availability, and what local buyers prefer. You can select the right variety by comparing how fast each type grows, how much yield it produces, and how it cooks and tastes after harvest.
ga: Omɔ henɔ fɛɛ henɔ woɔ yibii sɔrɔtoi yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nu ni yɔɔ kɛ nɔ ni maŋbii ni heɔ nii lɛ taoɔ Obaanyɛ ohala srɔtoi ni sa kɛtsɔ bɔ ni eko fɛɛ eko daa oya lɛ ni okɛtoɔ he lɛ nɔ. Mɛni obaanyɛ ofee? kɛ bɔ ni asaa he ahaa kɛ bɔ ni akaɔ he akwɛɔ yɛ ŋmaa lɛ sɛɛ

english: Why is it better to follow a step-by-step planting method instead of just scattering my seeds in the field?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehi akɛ ooonyiɛ gbɛ ni atsɔɔ nɔ aduɔ nii fiofio lɛ sɛɛ moŋ fe ni ooodu dumɔwui yɛ ŋmɔ mli lɛ?

english: Following proper planting steps—like nursing seeds first, planting in neat rows, and giving correct spacing—ensures every crop gets enough sunlight, water, and soil nutrients, leading to a bigger harvest compared to random seed scattering.
ga: Nyiɛmɔ gbɛ ni sa ni atsɔɔ nɔ aduɔ nii lɛ sɛɛ, tamɔ dumɔwui adumɔ klɛŋklɛŋ. Dumɔ yɛ ŋwɛigbɛ ni ato he gbɛjianɔ jogbaŋŋ ni okɛ sɛɛjɛkɛmɔ ni sa ahi shi Enɛ baaha tso fɛɛ tso aná hulu la, nu, kɛ niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa anáa kpamɔ babaoo kɛ akɛto dumɔwui ni aduɔ trukaa lɛ he.

english: Does the variety of rice I plant affect how it cooks and tastes after harvest?
ga: Ani ŋmãa srɔtoi ni miduɔ lɛ saa bɔ ni ahoɔ lɛ ahaa kɛ bɔ ni ŋmãa yɔɔ ha beni akpa lɛ sɛɛ?

english: Yes, crop varieties have different traits such as grain size, aroma, texture, and cooking time. Testing how a crop cooks and tastes helps you choose the variety that consumers in the market actually want to buy.
ga: Hɛɛ, tsei srɔtoi yɛ sui srɔtoi tamɔ dumɔwui lɛ adalɛ, amɛhenumɔ, bɔ ni amɛyɔɔ ha kɛ be ni akɛhooɔ nii. Kɛ́ oka bɔ ni tsei hoɔ nii amɛhaa kɛ bɔ ni amɛnuɔ nii ahe amɛhaa lɛ okwɛ lɛ, eyeɔ ebua bo ni ohalaa srɔtoi ni mɛi ni heɔ nii yɛ jara nɔ lɛ sumɔɔ diɛŋtsɛ ni amɛhe.

english: Can I try growing a small batch of a new crop variety before planting my whole field with it?
ga: Mibaanyɛ maka akɛ makwɛ tso bibioo ko ni ji tso hee ko. Ani manyɛ madu ŋmɔ muu lɛ fɛɛ dani madu?

english: Yes, testing a small sample allows you to see how the variety behaves in your farm's local weather and soil conditions without taking a large financial risk on your entire acreage.
ga: Hɛɛ, nɔkwɛmɔnɔ bibioo kaa Yeɔ ebua bo ni ona henɔi srɔtoi lɛ. Te efeɔ enii ehaa tɛŋŋ yɛ oŋmɔ lɛ mli kɔɔyɔŋ tsakemɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ? ni okɛ shika he oshara kpele ko akawo ogbɛhe muu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ.

english: Why do some rice varieties give more food at harvest than the traditional ones I usually plant?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa henɔi komɛi yeɔ nii babaoo yɛ kpamɔ sɛɛ fe blema ŋmãa ni miduɔ lɛ?

english: Improved crop varieties are bred to handle local weather better, resist common diseases, and produce fuller grain heads, which results in more bags of food per acre.
ga: Afɔ tsei srɔtoi ni afee amɛ jogbaŋŋ lɛ koni amɛnyɛ amɛtsu he ni amɛyɔɔ lɛ kɔɔyɔŋ tsakemɔ lɛ he nii jogbaŋŋ. Enyɛɔ eshiɔ helai ni afɔɔ namɔ ni ekɛ dumɔwui ayitsei ni yeɔ emuu babaoo baa Enɛ haa niyenii kotokui babaoo baa acre kome mli.

english: Why does some harvested rice break easily into small pieces when it is milled?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ kɛ́ akpa ŋmãa komɛi lɛ, egbɛɔ eshwaa bibii bibii oya lɛ?

english: Rice breaks during milling if the seed variety has softer grains or if it wasn't dried properly after harvest. Choosing sturdy varieties and learning the right drying process keeps the grains whole.
ga: Omɔ baatse yɛ be mli ni aŋmɔɔ lɛ kɛji akɛ ŋmãa lɛ yɛ dumɔwui ni yɔɔ blɛoo loo kɛji akɛ agbiko lɛ jogbaŋŋ yɛ ŋmãa lɛ sɛɛ. Kɛ́ ohala ŋmaa henɔi ni wa ni okase gbɛ ni ja ni atsɔɔ nɔ agbiɔ lɛ, ebaaha ŋmaa lɛ akafee nɔ ni eye emuu.

english: Where can I go to learn the correct step-by-step process for growing modern crop varieties?
ga: Nɛgbɛ manyɛ maya ni makase gbɛ ni ja ni atsɔɔ nɔ aduɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ beaŋ tsei lɛ yɛ gbɛ ni ja nɔ?

english: You can visit agricultural extension centers or practical training facilities where officers show you demo plots, walk you through every stage from planting to harvest, and let you test the final produce.
ga: Obaanyɛ oyasara okwaayeli he nitsumɔ he ko loo tsɔsemɔ he ko ni anyɛɔ atsuɔ he nii yɛ. he ni onukpai lɛ baajie nɔkwɛmɔnɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ kpo yɛ lɛ Tsɔɔmɔ gbɛ fɛɛ gbɛ nɔ kɛjɛ dumɔwui kɛyashi ŋmaakpamɔ nɔ. ni oha oka naagbee nibii lɛ okwɛ.

english: Why do some rice varieties grow well in wet valleys while others die if there is too much water?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa henɔi komɛi kwɛ̃ɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ jɔɔ lɛ mli ni nu yɔɔ lɛ? Yɛ be mli ni srɔtoi komɛi gboiɔ kɛji nu babaoo yɛ jɛmɛ lɛ?

english: Different crop varieties are suited for different environments; lowland varieties thrive in standing water, whereas upland varieties are suited for drier soils and will rot if submerged.
ga: Tsei srɔtoi lɛ sa kɛha shihilɛi srɔtoi. Shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ nɔ tsei lɛ daa jogbaŋŋ yɛ nu ni yɔɔ dioo mli. yɛ be mli ni gɔŋ nɔ henɔi lɛ hi kɛha shikpɔŋ ni egbi ni ebaagbo kɛji akɛ awo amɛ shishi.

english: Is it okay to mix different rice seed varieties together in the same plot?
ga: Ani abaanyɛ afutu ŋmãa dumɔwui srɔtoi yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ?

english: It is best to keep varieties separate because each type matures at a different speed and needs different care. Mixing them makes weeding, harvesting, and selling much harder.
ga: Ehi jogbaŋŋ akɛ aaagbala kooloi srɔtoi lɛ amli kɛjɛ amɛhe. Nɔ hewɔ ji akɛ, srɔtoi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko daa oya, ni ehe hiaa ni akwɛ amɛ jogbaŋŋ. Kɛ́ okɛ amɛ futu mli lɛ, ebaagbe jwɛi lɛ. kpamɔɔ Ni jarayeli wa kwraa fe nakai.

english: How can I check if my harvested crop will be acceptable to buyers before taking it to the market?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ makwɛ kɛji mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ baakpɛlɛ mikpamɔ lɛ nɔ dani mikɛwo jara nɔ?

english: You can evaluate a small sample by processing and preparing it as a consumer would—checking for good appearance, pleasant smell, and desirable cooking texture that buyers look for.
ga: Obaanyɛ okwɛ nɔkwɛmɔnɔ bibioo ko mli. Anáa kɛtsɔ nitsumɔ kɛ ehe saamɔ nɔ tamɔ bɔ ni jarayelɔ baafee lɛ nɔ. Kɛtsɔ bɔ ni ehe yɔɔ fɛo, bɔ ni eyɔɔ ŋmɔlɔ kɛ bɔ ni ahoɔ nii ahaa ni mɛi ni heɔ nii lɛ taoɔ lɛ mlipɛimɔ nɔ.

english: Yellowing lower leaves indicate a lack of nitrogen in the soil. Nitrogen is essential for leafy growth and green color, so adding nitrogen fertilizer or well-rotted manure helps restore health to your maize crop.
ga: Baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Nitrogen he hiaa waa kɛha baa lɛ dalɛ kɛ eŋɔli su. No hewɔ lɛ, kɛ́ okɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii ni egbo jogbaŋŋ fata he lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni o-abele tsei lɛ aná hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: How does growing groundnuts or cowpeas help improve my soil for the next crop?
ga: Te abaafee tɛŋŋ ni ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei ni aduɔ lɛ aha mishikpɔŋ lɛ aya hiɛ kɛha miŋmɔshi nibii ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ?

english: Groundnuts and cowpeas are legumes that trap nitrogen from the air and store it in their roots. When the plants die, this trapped nitrogen releases into the soil, making it naturally fertile for heavy-feeding crops like maize.
ga: Peas kɛ cowpeas ji ŋmeii ni mɔ̃ɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛtoɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ amli. Kɛ́ tso lɛ gbo lɛ, nɛkɛ nitrogen ni amɔmɔ lɛ nɛɛ jeɔ kpo kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa efeɔ nɔ ni baa shi yɛ adebɔɔ naa kɛha kooloi aniyenii ni tsii, tamɔ ŋmãa.

english: Why is it bad to apply chemical fertilizer when the soil is completely dry?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehiii akɛ akɛ tsofai ni akɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ baawo mli beni shikpɔŋ lɛ egbi kwraa lɛ?

english: Fertilizers need moisture to dissolve so that plant roots can absorb the nutrients. Applying fertilizer to dry soil can burn and damage the plant roots, wasting your inputs.
ga: Nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmɔ mli lɛ ahe miihia ni nu atsɔ mli bɔni afee ni tsei shishifãi lɛ anyɛ aŋɔ niyenii mli hewalɛ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii wo shikpɔŋ ni egbi mli lɛ, ebaanyɛ eshã ni efite tsei shishifãi. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji nibii ni akɛfeɔ nii lɛ ni laajeɔ.

english: Young cocoa trees burn easily under intense sunlight. Plantains grow fast and feature wide leaves that act as natural shade umbrellas, protecting the young cocoa plants and keeping the soil moist during their first few years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni naa wa shishi. Plantains daa oya ni eyɛ baai ni mli kwɔlɔ ni tsuɔ nii akɛ adebɔɔ mli hulutsoo. Ebuɔ kookoo tsei bibii ahe, ni ehaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ feɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ klɛŋklɛŋ afii fioo lɛ amli.

english: Why do I need to use tall poles to stake my yam vines?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ tso kakadaŋŋ he hiaa mi koni mikɛwo mi-sweet potato wain tso lɛ nɔ lɛ?

english: Yams need maximum sunlight on their leaves to generate energy for building tubers underground. Staking lifts the leaves off the ground toward the sun while keeping them away from soil-borne diseases.
ga: Sweet potatoes he miihia hulu la ni fa babaoo yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ koni ekɛ hewalɛ aha tuber feemɔ. Staking haa baai lɛ teɔ shi kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ kɛyaa hulu lɛ he. Yɛ nakai beaŋ nɔŋŋ lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni atsĩɔ helai ni jɛɔ shikpɔŋ mli baa lɛ anaa.

english: Why do my cassava tubers rot inside the ground before harvest time?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava shishifãi lɛ miifite yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli dani kpamɔɔ be lɛ?

english: Tubers rot when water collects around the roots in heavy or poorly drained soil during heavy rains. Planting cassava on raised ridges or mounds lets excess water drain away, protecting tubers from fungal rot.
ga: Tubers lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu bua ehe naa yɛ shishifãi lɛ ahe yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli wa loo shikpɔŋ ni nu hoɔ jogbaŋŋ yɛ mli yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli. Kɛ́ adu ŋmei yɛ gɔŋ ko nɔ loo gɔŋ ko ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ, ebaaha nu ni fa fe nine lɛ atsɔ mli. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ebuɔ ŋmeii ahe kɛjɛɔ ŋmeii ahe.

english: Tomato flowers drop when temperatures become excessively high or when water supply is irregular. Stress prevents proper pollination, so keeping soil moisture consistent with mulching and watering helps fruit form.
ga: Tomato fɔfɔi lɛ baagbee shi kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa tsɔ loo kɛ́ nu ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ ejaaa. Haomɔ tsiɔ pollination ni sa naa. No hewɔ lɛ, shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni akwɛɔ nɔ be fɛɛ be kɛtsɔ ŋmɔtɔ kɛ nu ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni ewo yibii.

english: Why do my heavy plantain trees keep falling over during windstorms?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi dumɔwui ni tsii lɛ gbeeɔ shi yɛ ahum be mli lɛ?

english: Plantains have shallow roots that struggle to support the heavy weight of a mature fruit bunch. Supporting the stem with a strong wooden or bamboo fork prop prevents wind from uprooting the tree.
ga: Plantains yɛ shishifãi ni mli ekwɔɔɔ ni bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ koni amɛfi aduawai akui ni edara lɛ amli tsiimɔ ni tsii lɛ sɛɛ. Kɛ́ okɛ ŋmei tso loo fɔk ni wa fĩ tso lɛ shishi lɛ, ebaatsi kɔɔyɔɔ naa koni ekajie tso lɛ shishi.

english: Why are the leaves on my pepper plants curling upwards and growing twisted?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ lɛ miibɔle amɛhe ni amɛmiibɔle amɛhe lɛ?

english: Curled leaves are usually caused by tiny sucking insects like whiteflies or thrips, which feed on sap and spread plant viruses. Spraying plants early with neem oil extract helps control these pests.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii ni nuɔ nu tamɔ whiteflies loo thrips ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni ebɔle ehe lɛ baa. ni yeɔ nu lɛ mli nu lɛ ni egbɛɔ helai ni gbeɔ mɔ lɛ eshwaa tsei amli Ni akɛ neem fɔ ni ajieɔ kɛjɛɔ mli lɛ ashwieɔ tsei anɔ mra Ebaaye ebua ni akudɔ nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ.

english: Weeds compete directly with your crops for sunlight, water, space, and soil nutrients. If weeds remain in the field, they steal the fertilizer you applied before your main crops get the chance to use it.
ga: Jwɛi kɛ oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ yeɔ akaŋ tɛ̃ɛ kɛha hulu la, nu, ŋwɛi, kɛ shikpɔŋ nɔ niyenii. Kɛji jwɛi tee nɔ ehi ŋmɔ lɛ mli Amɛbaaju ŋmɔshi nibii ni okɛwoɔ mli lɛ dani ŋmɔshi nibii titri lɛ aná hegbɛ ni amɛkɛtsu nii.

english: When maize leaves turn yellow at the bottom in a V-pattern, it usually means the crop is starving for nitrogen. The plant moves food from its lower leaves to feed the new growth at the top, causing the bottom leaves to yellow and dry up.
ga: Kɛji akɛ ŋmãa baai lɛ tsɔ ŋmɔŋ yɛ shishigbɛ yɛ V su mli lɛ, bei pii lɛ etsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ ŋmãa lɛ mli. Tso lɛ tsiɔ niyenii kɛjɛɔ baai ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ amli koni ekɛha nɔ hee ni eda yɛ ŋwɛi lɛ niyenii. Enɛ haa baai ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbiɔ.

english: Why should I not plant cassava on the exact same piece of land year after year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ miduɔ ŋmei yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ afi fɛɛ afi lɛ?

english: Planting cassava repeatedly on the same plot drains the exact same nutrients from the soil every season and allows cassava-specific pests to build up in the dirt. Rotating with crops like groundnuts or cowpeas puts nitrogen back into the soil.
ga: Kasava ni aduɔ shii abɔ Yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ lɛ, niyenii mli hewalɛ kome too lɛ nɔŋŋ baaje shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ daa be. ni eyeɔ ebuaa kooloi bibii ni yeɔ ŋmei pɔtɛɛ lɛ ni amɛbuaa amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Nibii ni aduɔ tamɔ ŋmei loo tsina ŋmei ni atsakeɔ lɛ haa nitrogen kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ.

english: How do I know if the first rain of the season is enough for me to sow my maize seeds?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male akɛ klɛŋklɛŋ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ yɛ be lɛ mli lɛ fa bɔ ni sa ni manyɛ madu ŋmãa?

english: You should not plant after just one short shower because the dry soil underneath will quickly absorb the moisture and dry out your seeds. Wait until the soil is thoroughly wet down to the depth of your hand before planting.
ga: Esaaa akɛ oduɔ nii yɛ nu fioo pɛ sɛɛ. shikome pɛ Enɛ ji akɛ, shikpɔŋ ni egbi ni yɔɔ shishigbɛ lɛ shwieɔ nu oya ni ehaa dumɔwui lɛ gbɛ́ɔ. Mɛɛ ni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee ŋmɔtɔ kwraa kɛyashɛ onine mli dani okɛdu.

english: Cassava roots rot when excess water collects in the soil and cannot drain away. Planting your cassava on raised mounds or ridges allows water to run off, keeping the roots well-aerated and healthy.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ kɛji nu ni fa fe nine lɛ bua ehe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ni enyɛɛɛ efo kɛya. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkei lɛ anɔ lɛ haa nu hoɔ. Ehaa shishifãi lɛ naa kɔɔyɔɔ kpakpa ni amɛtsɔɔ mli ni amɛhe wa.

english: Why are the leaves of my pepper plants curling up and stopping from growing?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper baai lɛ miihoso ni amɛmiikpa dalɛ lɛ?

english: Leaf curling in pepper plants is usually caused by tiny insects like whiteflies or thrips sucking the sap from the leaves and spreading plant viruses. Spraying the leaves with neem leaf extract helps control these insects.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ whiteflies loo thrips ni nuɔ baai lɛ amli nu lɛ ni amɛgbɛɔ helai ni baa tso lɛ mli lɛ baa lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ pepper tsei amli. Kɛ́ okɛ neem tso mli nu lɛ shwie baai lɛ anɔ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni akudɔ nɛkɛ kooloi nɛɛ.

english: Why do my cocoa flowers fall off without turning into small pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-kokoo fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛtsakeee amɛfeɔ ŋmeii bibii lɛ?

english: Cocoa trees drop flowers when they are stressed by hot dry weather, severe shade, or insect attacks like mirid bugs. Managing shade tree canopy and protecting early flowers helps the pods set properly.
ga: Cocoa tsei fɔɔ fɔfɔi kɛji shihilɛi ni mli edɔ ni nu egbi lɛ hao amɛ. Shade ni naa wa. loo kooloi bibii ni tutuaa amɛ tamɔ ŋmeii, tso lɛ mli ŋmɔlɔ ni akwɛɔ nɔ kɛ fɔfɔi ahe ni abuɔ mra lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmeii lɛ shwieɔ shi jogbaŋŋ.

english: If I plant my maize seeds very close together, won't I get a bigger harvest from my land?
ga: Kɛ midu ŋmãa dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe waa Ani maná yibiiwoo babaoo kɛjɛ mishikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ?

english: No, planting seeds too close together forces the crops to compete with each other for sunlight, water, and soil food. This results in thin, weak stems and tiny or empty cobs, leading to a smaller overall harvest.
ga: Dabi, dumɔwui ni aduɔ yɛ he ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ nyɛɔ tsei lɛ anɔ koni amɛye hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Enɛ haa tsei bibii ni bɛ hewalɛ kɛ tsei bibii loo nɔ ko bɛ mli lɛ baa. Nɔ ni baajɛ mli aba ji akɛ, nikpamɔ lɛ fɛɛ baafee bibioo.

english: Yam leaves need maximum sunlight to manufacture the food that grows the tubers under the ground. Staking lifts the vines up to catch sunlight and keeps the leaves away from damp ground diseases.
ga: Sweet potato baai lɛ biɔ hulu la babaoo koni amɛná niyenii kɛ́ adu ŋmeii lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi. Staking woɔ wain tso lɛ nɔ kɛyaa hulu la mli ni ebuɔ tso lɛ baai lɛ ahe kɛjɛɔ helai ahe yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ nɔ.

english: Why are my small green mangoes dropping off the tree before they grow big?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi mango bibii ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ miiho kɛmiijɛ tso lɛ nɔ dani amɛdara lɛ?

english: Young mangoes drop when the tree lacks water during dry spells or when fruit flies lay eggs inside the fruit. Keeping the ground clean under the tree and watering during flower-to-fruit transformation reduces drop.
ga: Mango bibii lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ nu bɛ tso lɛ nɔ yɛ fɛ̃i be mli loo kɛ́ aduawai amli ŋmeii wo amɛwui yɛ aduawai lɛ amli. Kɛ́ shikpɔŋ lɛ he tse yɛ tsei lɛ ashishi, ni oooha nu yɛ fɔfɔii kɛ yibiiwoo teŋ lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni tso lɛ yibii lɛ ni shwieɔ shi lɛ aba shi.

english: Why do weeds lower my crop yield even after I put fertilizer on my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi haa miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ baa shi eyɛ mli akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ ŋmɔ lɛ mli moŋ?

english: Weeds grow faster and have stronger roots than standard farm crops, meaning they steal the fertilizer, water, and sunlight before your crops get a chance to absorb them.
ga: Jwɛi lɛ daa oya ni amɛshishifãi lɛ wa fe ŋmɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii krokomɛi. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ amɛjuɔ ŋmɔshi nibii, nu, kɛ hulu la dani oŋmɔshi nibii lɛ náa hegbɛ ni amɛŋɔ amɛ.

english: Why are the lower leaves of my maize plants turning yellow and dry before the crop is mature?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abɛi tsei lɛ ashishigbɛ baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ ni amɛgbiɔ dani tsei lɛ daa lɛ?

english: Yellowing lower leaves usually mean the soil lacks nitrogen, which plants need to stay green and healthy. As the maize grows, it takes nitrogen from its older leaves to feed the new top leaves, causing the bottom ones to turn yellow.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, shishigbɛ baai ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. ni ehe hiaa ni tsei lɛ ahi shi eŋɔli ni amɛná hewalɛ Beni ŋmãa lɛ miida lɛ Esa akɛ akɛ Nitrogen ni jɛ baai momo mli lɛ atsu nii ni akɛha ŋwɛi baa heei lɛ niyenii. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, baai ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ.

english: Why do my vegetable leaves droop and curl up during the hot afternoon but look fresh again in the morning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ aduawai ahe baai lɛ shwieɔ shi ni amɛfeɔ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ yɛ shwane ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli, shi amɛkuɔ amɛsɛɛ amɛbaa kɛ hejɔɔmɔ leebi lɛ?

english: Plants lose water faster through their leaves under direct hot sun than their roots can take up from the soil. They droop to protect themselves and save moisture, then recover overnight when the temperature drops.
ga: Tsei laajeɔ nu oya kɛtsɔɔ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ yɛ hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ shishi. Nɔ ni fe bɔ ni shishifãi lɛ baanyɛ ajie kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Amɛgbeeɔ shi koni amɛkɛbu amɛhe ni amɛhiɛ ŋmɔtɔ mli. No sɛɛ lɛ, ehiɛɔ shi nyɔɔŋ kome mli kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ ba shi.

english: Why are the blossoms falling off my tomato plants without turning into any tomatoes?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi ni etsɔɔɔ tomato lɛ?

english: Tomato plants drop their flowers when temperatures get too high or when rainfall is unpredictable. High heat stresses the plant, making it drop flowers to preserve energy rather than growing fruit.
ga: Tomato tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛfɔfɔi lɛ shi kɛ́ hulutsoo be lɛ tee hiɛ tsɔ loo kɛ́ nugbɔ nɛ yɛ gbɛ ni ejaaa nɔ. Dɔlɛ ni naa wa haa tsei haoɔ. Gbalamɔ fɔfɔii koni okɛto hewalɛ he moŋ fe ni oookwɛ aduawai.

english: Why do I need to plant plantain trees beside my young cocoa seedlings?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ehe hiaa ni madu plantain yɛ mi-kokoo tso bibioo lɛ masɛi lɛ?

english: Young cocoa seedlings have tender leaves that burn easily in direct sunlight. Plantain trees grow quickly and have large leaves that provide living shade and keep the soil cool until the cocoa trees grow strong enough.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ yɛ baai bibii ni shãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ mli. Dumɔwui lɛ daa oya ni amɛyɛ baai agboi ni haa hulutsoo ni ehaa sũ lɛ mli jɔɔ kɛyashiɔ be mli ni cacao tsei lɛ daa waa bɔ ni sa.

english: Why do people advise me to plant groundnuts on my farmland before planting maize the next season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mɛi woɔ ŋaa akɛ madu ŋmei yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli dani madu ŋmei yɛ afi ni baa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that take nitrogen from the air and store it in the soil through their roots. When you plant maize afterward, the maize uses that trapped nitrogen to grow bigger and yield more without needing as much artificial fertilizer.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni amɛkɛtoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛtsɔɔ amɛshishifãi lɛ anɔ. Kɛji odu ŋmãa sɛɛ mli lɛ ŋmãa kɛ nitrogen ni ato lɛ tsuɔ nii koni ekwɛ̃ ni ewo ŋmãa babaoo ni ehe ehiaaa ni akɛ ŋmãa ni akɛfee lɛ babaoo awo mli.

english: Why shouldn't I place fertilizer directly against the stem of my cassava plants?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ ŋmɔshi nibii woɔ ŋmei tsei lɛ anɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ?

english: Fertilizer contains concentrated chemical salts that can burn the stem and root system if placed directly on them. Spreading fertilizer in a small circle a few inches away allows the feeder roots to drink the nutrients safely.
ga: Tsofai ni mli eyi obɔ kɛ ŋmeii ni baanyɛ ashã tso lɛ shishi kɛ shishifãi lɛ yɛ ŋmɔshi nibii amli kɛji akɛ akɛwo mli tɛ̃ɛ. Okɛ ŋmɔshi nibii awo mli yɛ kooyigbɛ bibii amli. Inchi fioo komɛi ni yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ baaha shishifãi ni yeɔ niyenii lɛ anu niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ lɛ shweshweeshwe.

english: Yam vines need direct sunlight on as many leaves as possible to manufacture food for the growing underground tuber. Lifting the leaves off the damp ground also prevents leaves from rotting and catching diseases.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ he miihia hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ yɛ amɛbaai lɛ anɔ bɔ ni eeenyɛ koni amɛná niyenii amɛha shikpɔŋ shishi tsei ni miida lɛ. Kɛ́ ajie baai kɛjɛ hei ni ŋmɔtɔ yɔɔ lɛ hu, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaaa amɛgboi ni helai akamɔ amɛ.

english: Cassava roots need air in the soil to stay healthy. When excess rainwater sits in the soil without draining, the roots drown and soil bacteria cause them to turn soft and rot. Planting on raised ridges helps water drain away.
ga: Kasava shishifãi lɛ he miihia ni kɔɔyɔɔ ahi shikpɔŋ lɛ mli koni amɛhi shi jogbaŋŋ. Beni afu nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ awo shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni nu hoɔ yɛ jɛmɛ. Shishifãi lɛ baagbee nu mli ni helatsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ baaha amɛfee blɛoo ni amɛgboi. Dumɔ ni aduɔ yɛ ŋshɔkpɔ ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ haa nu hoɔ kɛyaa.

english: Why are small caterpillars chewing ragged holes right in the center fold of my young maize leaves?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii bibii miiye bu yɛ mi-baby corn baai lɛ ateŋ ŋmeii lɛ amli lɛ?

english: These caterpillars are Fall Armyworms, which like to hide inside the central growing point of young maize because the leaves are soft and sweet. If not controlled early, they eat the leaves before the plant can form an ear of corn.
ga: Nɛkɛ ŋmeii nɛɛ ji Fall Armyworms, ni sumɔɔ ni amɛhiɛ amɛhe yɛ ŋmeii bibii ni kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ teŋgbɛ lɛ amli ejaakɛ baai lɛ yɛ bɔdɔɔ ni amɛmli ŋɔɔ. Kɛji akɛ akudɔɔɔ mra Amɛyeɔ baai lɛ dani tsei lɛ daraa ni amɛfeɔ ŋmãa toi.

english: Why do the seeds I saved from last year's hybrid maize produce smaller yields than the original packet of seeds I bought?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni mikɛto kɛjɛ afi ni ho lɛ mli ŋmãa ni akɛfee ŋmãa lɛ mli lɛ woɔ yibii fioo fe shishijee dumɔwui ni mihe lɛ?

english: Hybrid seeds are specifically bred from two parent plants to produce a high yield for one generation only. Seeds saved from that harvest lose their special hybrid strength, resulting in weaker plants and smaller harvests.
ga: Akɛ dumɔwui ni akɛfee ekome lɛ fɔ̃ɔ tɛ̃ɛ kɛjɛɔ fɔlɔi tsei enyɔ amli koni amɛwo yibii babaoo kɛha yinɔ kome pɛ. Dumɔwui ni abua naa kɛjɛɔ nakai kpamɔ lɛ mli lɛ laajeɔ amɛ hybrid hewalɛ krɛdɛɛ lɛ. Enɛ haa tsei lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni yibiiwoo lɛ hu baa shi.

english: Why do my cassava leaves turn yellow and drop off when I suddenly change the type of fertilizer mid-season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmei baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ trukaa ni amɛshwieɔ shi lɛ? No hewɔ lɛ, tsakemɔ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ henɔ yɛ be lɛ teŋgbɛ?

english: Cassava roots adjust their nutrient absorption based on what is available early in growth; sudden shifts in soil chemical composition shock the plant's metabolic system, causing leaf drop as a stress response.
ga: Cassava shishifãi tsakeɔ niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni amɛyeɔ lɛ mli yɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ amɛdalɛ mra lɛ nɔ. Tsakemɔi ni baa trukaa yɛ tsofai ni yɔɔ sũ lɛ mli lɛ mli lɛ woɔ tso lɛ mli nibii ni haa mɔ he jɔɔ lɛ amli. Enɛ haa baai lɛ laajeɔ akɛ nɔnyɛɛ hetoo.

english: If I plant my maize late after the main rainy season begins, why does it produce smaller cobs even if it gets water later on?
ga: Kɛji midu ŋmãa yɛ sɛɛ mli beni nugbɔshiimɔ be titri lɛ eje shishi lɛ Mɛni hewɔ ehaa ŋmeii lɛ feɔ bibii lɛ? Namɔ náa nu yɛ sɛɛ mli?

english: Maize relies on specific daylight hours and early temperature triggers during its vegetative stage to determine cob size; delaying planting disrupts these natural triggers, forcing the plant to flower early with smaller cobs.
ga: Abɛi damɔɔ hulutsoo be pɔtɛɛ kɛ hulutsoo be mli mra yɛ be mli ni edaa lɛ nɔ koni etsɔɔ bɔ ni ŋmei lɛ dalɛ ji. Dumɔ ni asɛɛ tsɛɔ lɛ tsiɔ nɛkɛ adebɔɔ mli nibii ni tsiɔ mɔ naa nɛɛ anaa. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, esa akɛ tsei lɛ awo fɔfɔi mra ni amɛná fɔfɔi bibii bibii.

english: I am a young person starting my first farm; why do tomato plants need wooden stakes while pepper plants can stand on their own?
ga: Oblanyo fioo ji mi ni mijeɔ mi klɛŋklɛŋ ŋmɔ lɛ shishi. Mɛni hewɔ tsei ahe hiaa tomato tsei lɛ? Yɛ be mli ni pepper tso baanyɛ adamɔ shi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ?

english: Tomato plants have flexible, vining stems that easily bend under heavy fruit weight and rot on damp soil, whereas pepper plants naturally form woody, erect stems capable of holding fruit off the ground.
ga: Tomato tsei yɛ ŋmeii ni nyɛɔ efoɔ kɛ wain tsei ni shwieɔ shi oya yɛ aduawai ni tsii ni tsii shishi ni amɛgboɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli efɔ nɔ. Shi yɛ gbɛ kroko nɔ lɛ, pepper tsei feɔ adebɔɔ mli tsei ni damɔ shi shiŋŋ ni baanyɛ aŋɔ aduawai kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ.

english: Why do my cowpea plants grow many green leaves but very few pods when planted under the shade of big trees?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ yɛ baai eŋɔli babaoo shi ŋmeii fioo pɛ yɔɔ mli kɛ́ adu lɛ yɛ tso agbo ko shishi lɛ?

english: Cowpeas require direct, uninterrupted sunlight to trigger flower and pod formation. In shaded areas, the plant spends all its energy stretching leaves toward the light instead of producing fruit.
ga: Cowpeas biɔ hulu la ni yaa nɔ tɛ̃ɛ koni ekanya fɔfɔi kɛ ŋmeii. Yɛ hei ni hulutsoo yɔɔ lɛ Tso lɛ baafite ehewalɛ fɛɛ ni ekɛgbala ebaai lɛ kɛya la lɛ he moŋ fe ni eeewo yibii.

english: Why does high-yielding hybrid maize produce such poor harvests if I save seeds from my harvest to plant next season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa ni akɛwoɔ ŋmãa ni woɔ yibii babaoo lɛ wooo yibii jogbaŋŋ nɛkɛ lɛ? Kɛji mikɛ dumɔwui ni jɛ kpamɔ be lɛ mli lɛ to koni mikɛdu yɛ be ni baa lɛ mli

english: Hybrid seeds are bred from two specific parent lines to create high vigor for one generation only; saving seeds from that harvest causes the genetic traits to split, producing uneven and low-yielding plants.
ga: Akɛ dumɔwui ni akɛfee ekome lɛ fɔɔ kɛjɛɔ fɔlɔi akui enyɔ mli tɛ̃ɛ koni ekɛ hewalɛ ni nɔ kwɔ aba yinɔ kome pɛ mli. Dumɔwui ni abuɔ he kɛjɛɔ kpamɔ lɛ he lɛ haa fɔmɔ sui ni yɔɔ mli lɛ fiteɔ. Enɛ haa ŋmɔshi nibii ni anáa lɛ kɛ amɛhe kpaaa gbee, ni ŋmɔshi nibii ni anáa lɛ hu baa shi.

english: Why do young cocoa trees fail to grow well in sandy soil even when I supply them with water?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ cacao tsei bibii nyɛɛɛ akwɛ̃ jogbaŋŋ yɛ ŋã shikpɔŋ nɔ eyɛ mli akɛ mihaa amɛ nu moŋ?

english: Sandy soil lacks the organic matter needed to hold onto nutrients and anchor deep roots. Cocoa trees require deep clay-loam soils that retain organic nutrients and steady moisture.
ga: Shikpɔŋ ni ŋã yɔɔ nɔ lɛ bɛ nibii ni he hiaa ni baaha niyenii mli hewalɛ ni haa shishifãi ni mli kwɔ lɛ ahi shi lɛ. Cocoa tsei lɛ taoɔ shikpɔŋ ni mli kwɔ, ni ji shikpɔŋ ni mli edɔ ni hiɛɔ niyenii ni wala yɔɔ mli kɛ ŋmɔtɔ daa.

english: Why do my watermelon fruits split open right on the vine right before they are ready for harvest?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-watermelon lɛ miikwɛ̃ yɛ wain tso lɛ nɔ dani amɛfee klalo akɛ amɛbaakpa lɛ?

english: A heavy rain or sudden watering after a dry period causes the inside flesh of the watermelon to expand faster than its outer skin can stretch, creating internal pressure that cracks the fruit open.
ga: Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa loo nu ni ashwieɔ trukaa yɛ be ko sɛɛ lɛ baaha watermelon lɛ mligbɛ agbɛ ashwã oya fe bɔ ni kponɔgbɛ fã lɛ baanyɛ agbɛ ashwã. Enɛ haa mligbɛ nɔnyɛɛ baa ni haa aduawai lɛ tswaa.

english: Why are the flowers falling off my pepper plants without producing any fruit during hot dry spells?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ fɔfɔii shwieɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ nɔ ni ewooo yibii yɛ hulutsoo be mli lɛ?

english: High air temperatures combined with dry conditions put pepper plants under severe stress, causing them to shed flowers to save water and energy rather than feeding developing seeds.
ga: Kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ waa kɛ shihilɛi ni mli egbi lɛ kɛ pepper tsei lɛ woɔ haomɔ ni naa wa shishi. Nɔ ni jɛɔ mli baa ji akɛ, amɛfɔ̃ɔ fɔfɔi koni amɛkɛbu nu kɛ hewalɛ he moŋ fe ni amɛaaha amɛdumɔwui ni miida lɛ niyenii.

english: Why is it bad for my land if I plant groundnuts on the exact same plot every year?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mishikpɔŋ lɛ ehiii kɛji midu ŋmeii yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ daa afi lɛ?

english: Planting groundnuts repeatedly in the same soil allows leguminous pests and fungal diseases to build up while draining specific micro-nutrients, leading to weak roots and poor yields over time.
ga: Aduɔ ŋmeii shii abɔ Yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ lɛ, ŋmeii kɛ ŋmeii helai buaa amɛhe naa yɛ be mli ni amɛshwieɔ niyenii bibii komɛi ni haa mɔ he waa lɛ. Enɛ haa shishifãi lɛ bɛ hewalɛ ni amɛwoɔ yibii jogbaŋŋ yɛ be ni sa mli.

english: Why do my yam vines need to climb high on wooden stakes to grow large tubers under the ground?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mi-sweet potato wain tso lɛ akwɔ ŋwɛi shɔɔŋ yɛ tso ko nɔ koni ekɛ bulbs agboi akwɛ̃ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ?

english: Yam vines require tall stakes to expose maximum leaf area to direct sunlight, which drives high rates of photosynthesis that produce the food needed to fill and swell the underground tuber.
ga: Sweet potato wain tsei lɛ biɔ tsei kakadaji koni eha baa lɛ he lɛ aje kpo yɛ hulu la mli tɛ̃ɛ. Enɛ haa fotosintɛsis ni yaa hiɛ waa lɛ baa koni ekɛfee niyenii ni he hiaa koni akɛwo shikpɔŋ shishi ŋmeii lɛ amli ni amɛfuu lɛ.

english: Why do my maize leaves turn yellow when I plant them too close to my bean crops?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛ́ midu amɛ yɛ he ko ni bɛŋkɛ ŋmeii tsei lɛ tsɔ lɛ?

english: When crops are planted too close together, they fight for sunlight, root space, and nutrients. Yellowing leaves usually mean the corn is not getting enough light or nitrogen from the crowded soil.
ga: Kɛji akɛ adu tsei ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ lɛ Amɛyeɔ akaŋ koni amɛná hulu la, shishifãi ahe gbɛ, kɛ niyenii mli hewalɛ. Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ ŋmãa lɛ enaaa la loo nitrogen ni fa bɔ ni sa kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni eyi obɔ lɛ nɔ.

english: Why do extension officers advise us to plant beans in the same farm where we grow corn?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ extension nitsulɔi lɛ woɔ ŋaa akɛ adu ŋmeii yɛ ŋmɔ ni wɔduɔ ŋmeii yɛ mli lɛ nɔŋŋ mli lɛ?

english: Beans belong to a family of plants called legumes that pull nitrogen from the air and put it back into the soil, which naturally fertilizes and feeds the heavy-feeding corn plants.
ga: Beans ji ŋmeii ni atsɛɔ amɛ ŋmeii. ni gbalaa nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ekoŋŋ Enɛ ji adebɔɔ mli ŋmɔshi nibii kɛ niyenii kɛha ŋmãa tsei ni ayeɔ amɛ niyenii babaoo.

english: Why do my corn leaves roll up tightly into tubes during the hottest part of the day?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele baai lɛ shwieɔ shi shiŋŋ ni amɛfeɔ tsɔnei yɛ gbi lɛ mli be ni hulu lɛ tsoɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Corn leaves roll up as a natural defense to protect themselves from losing moisture through evaporation when the afternoon heat is high and the air is dry.
ga: Abɛi baai lɛ shwieɔ amɛhe amɛfeɔ adebɔɔ mli gbɛtsii nii ko ni baabu amɛhe kɛjɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni fiteɔ yɛ la ni hoɔ kɛyaa lɛ hewɔ beni shwane mli latsaa lɛ mli wa ni kɔɔyɔɔ lɛ mli egbi lɛ he.

english: What causes my green corn stalks to fall over easily during heavy rain or strong winds?
ga: Mɛni haa ŋmãa tsei ni yɔɔ ŋmɔji amli lɛ shwieɔ shi oya yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa loo kɔɔyɔɔ ni naa wa mli?

english: Corn stalks fall over—a condition called lodging—when their roots are weak, planted too shallowly, or damaged by soil pests like rootworms and stem borers.
ga: Abɛi tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi, shihilɛ ko ni ale lɛ akɛ shĩa. Beni shishifãi lɛ bɛ hewalɛ Aduɔ yɛ he ko ni mli ekwɔɔɔ tsɔ loo sũ mli tsɛŋemɔ helai tamɔ shishifãi ni shwieɔ shi kɛ shishifãi ni shwieɔ shi lɛ efiteɔ.

english: Why do my bean plants produce a lot of flowers but very few actual bean pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pea tso lɛ woɔ fɔfɔi babaoo shi pea ŋmɔji diɛŋtsɛ lɛ faaa lɛ?

english: Extreme heat or lack of water during the flowering stage causes bean flowers to drop off prematurely before they can be pollinated and form pods.
ga: Dɔlɛ ni naa wa loo nu ni bɛ yɛ fɔfɔii afeemɔ be mli lɛ haa ŋmei fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi oya dani amɛfeɔ ŋmeii ni amɛfeɔ ŋmeii.

english: Missing seeds at the tip happen when hot, dry weather damages the corn silk before pollen from the upper tassels can reach every part of the cob.
ga: Kɔɔyɔɔ ni elaaje yɛ ŋmeii lɛ ashishi lɛ baa beni kɔɔyɔɔ ni mli edɔ ni egbiɔ lɛ kpata ŋmeii lɛ ashishi dani ŋmeii ni jɛ ŋmeii lɛ anɔ ŋmeii lɛ amli lɛ baanyɛ ashɛ ŋmeii lɛ ahe fɛɛ.

english: Why do some of my planted seeds fail to come up out of the soil even after rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ dumɔwui ni miduɔ lɛ ejeee kpo kɛjɛɛɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ beni nugbɔ enɛ po lɛ?

english: Seeds may fail to sprout if they were planted too deep, eaten by insects under the soil, or rotted because the ground stayed too wet and muddy.
ga: Ekolɛ dumɔwui lɛ nyɛŋ akwɛ̃ kɛji akɛ adu amɛ shɔŋŋ tsɔ. Kplukai yeɔ lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi loo egboɔ ejaakɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ tsɔ ni eyɛ muji

english: How do I know if my bean crops are getting too much water in the soil?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji mi-bean tsei lɛ miiná nu babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli?

english: Too much water suffocates the plant roots by cutting off air, causing the leaves to turn pale green or yellow and look wilted even though the soil is wet.
ga: Nu babaoo haa tsei shishifãi lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛtsɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni efoɔ lɛ nɔ. Enɛ haa baai lɛ feɔ eŋɔli loo ŋmɔŋ ni etamɔ nɔ ni egbi, kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ edɔ po.

english: Why do small holes appear in my stored dried beans after a few weeks?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ bu bibioo ko yɔɔ jɛmɛ lɛ? Ejie ehe kpo yɛ mi-beans ni egbi ni mikɛto lɛ mli yɛ otsii fioo komɛi asɛɛ.

english: Small holes are caused by bean weevils (bruchids) that lay tiny eggs inside the seeds before or after harvest, which later hatch into insects that eat their way out.
ga: Buji bibii lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ ŋmeii (bruchids) ni woɔ ŋmeii bibii lɛ baa. Dumɔwu lɛ mli dani akpa loo yɛ ŋmaa lɛ sɛɛ Ni sɛɛ mli lɛ ebaatsɔ kooloi bibii ni yeɔ kpojee lɛ.

english: Why does my harvested corn turn moldy when stored in a closed room?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele ni mikpaa lɛ feɔ ŋmɔtɔ kɛ́ akɛto tsu ko ni aŋã mli lɛ?

english: Mold grows on harvested corn if the grains were not fully dried under the sun before storage, trapping moisture inside the closed room.
ga: Muji kwɛ̃ɔ yɛ ŋmãa ni akpa lɛ nɔ kɛji ŋmãa lɛ egbiko kwraa yɛ hulu lɛ mli dani akɛto. Kɛtsɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni ekɛwoɔ tsu ko ni aŋã mli lɛ mli lɛ nɔ.

english: Young cocoa trees are like delicate babies—they burn easily under direct sunlight. Plantains grow very fast and have huge leaves that act as living umbrellas, giving young cocoa the shade and cool soil it needs to survive its first few years.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii tamɔ abifabii ni bɛ hewalɛ—amɛshãa oya yɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ amɛ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ mli. Plantains daa oya waa ni eyɛ baai wuji ni tsuɔ nii akɛ hulutsoo. Enɛ haa kookoo bibii lɛ naa hulutsoo kɛ shikpɔŋ ni mli ejɔ ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛhi shi yɛ amɛshishijee afii lɛ amli.

english: Is it good for my crop yield if I plant cowpeas together on the same field with my maize?
ga: Ani ebaafee nɔ ni hi kɛha miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ kɛji mikɛ cowpea kɛ ŋmãa du yɛ shikpɔŋ kome nɔ?

english: Yes, planting cowpeas with maize helps your farm naturally. Cowpeas take nitrogen from the air and feed it into the soil, which acts as free fertilizer for the maize while protecting the soil from drying out.
ga: Hɛɛ, tsina ŋmãa ni akɛ ŋmãa duɔ lɛ yeɔ ebuaa ni oŋmɔ lɛ feɔ nɔ ni adebɔɔ yɔɔ mli. Cowpeas jieɔ nitrogen kɛjɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli ni ekɛwoɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli. ni tsuɔ nii akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni akɛwoɔ ŋmãa mli ni aheee nɔ ko kɛ agbɛnɛ hu ni ebuɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ he koni ekagbi

english: That damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm caterpillar. It hides in the central growing tip of the maize during the day to feed, and treating it early with recommended bio-pesticides or neem extracts prevents it from destroying your entire crop.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ fitemɔ baa ji Fall Armyworm ŋmei lɛ. Ekɛ ehe woɔ ŋmãa ni miida lɛ mli yɛ gbi lɛ mli koni eye niyenii. kɛ tsamɔ mra Kɛtsɔ tsofai ni gbeɔ kooloi loo neem mli nibii ni ajieɔ yi lɛ nɔ lɛ ebaatsi enaa koni ekafite onibii fɛɛ.

english: This is a sign of Cassava Mosaic Disease, which is spread by tiny insects called whiteflies or by using infected stem cuttings. Switching to disease-resistant cassava varieties from certified agricultural officers stops this problem.
ga: Enɛ ji ŋmei mosaic hela lɛ he okadi. Kooloi bibii ni atsɛɔ amɛ whiteflies loo tsei ni hela emɔ amɛ lɛ ni afoɔ lɛ gbɛɔ eshwaa. Kɛ́ okwaayeli he nitsulɔi ni yɔɔ hegbɛ lɛ atsake kɛya ŋmei srɔtoi ni helai nyɛɔ amɛyeɔ lɛ anɔ lɛ, ebaaha naagba nɛɛ akpa.

english: Why should I wait for the main rainy season to fully settle before planting my seeds?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ wɔmɛ kɛyashi nugbɔnɛmɔ be titri lɛ dani wɔdu dumɔwui lɛ?

english: Early rain showers can deceive you; if you plant too early and the rain stops for two weeks, the soil will dry out and bake your seeds underground before they can grow strong roots.
ga: Nugbɔ ni nɛɔ leebi maŋkpa lɛ baanyɛ alaka bo. Kɛji odu mra tsɔ ni nugbɔ lɛ kpa otsii enyɔ lɛ, Shikpɔŋ lɛ gĩɔ ni eshãa dumɔwui lɛ yɛ shikpɔŋ shishi dani amɛbaanyɛ amɛkwɛ̃ shishifãi ni wa.

english: Why do my pepper plant leaves drop off when the heat becomes too much during the dry season?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ hulutsoo be babaoo yɛ hulutsoo be lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Pepper plants drop leaves and flowers during extreme heat to conserve water and protect themselves from dying. Supplying mulch around the base and watering early in the morning helps keep the soil cool.
ga: Pepper tsei shwieɔ amɛbaai kɛ amɛfɔfɔi lɛ shi yɛ be mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa waa koni amɛkɛbu nu he ni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ gbele he. Kɛ́ akɛ sũ wo shishigbɛ lɛ he, ni akɛ nu wo mli leebi lɛ, eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa sũ lɛ mli jɔɔ.

english: Why shouldn't I just take the maize I bought from the local market to use as seeds on my farm?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esaaa akɛ mikɛ ŋmãa ni ahe yɛ maŋ lɛ mli jarayelihe lɛ tsuɔ nii akɛ dumɔwui yɛ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Market maize is meant for eating and may be an old variety or hybrid that will produce small, weak plants. Certified seeds bought from agro-dealers are specially selected to grow uniformly, resist local pests, and yield more bags.
ga: Afee jarayeli ŋmãa koni aye ni ebaanyɛ efee ŋmãa ni etsɛ loo ŋmãa ni akɛfee ŋmãa ni woɔ tsei bibii ni bɛ hewalɛ. Ahalaa dumɔwui ni yɔɔ hegbɛ ni aheɔ kɛjɛɔ okwaayeli mli jarayelɔi adɛŋ lɛ krɛdɛɛ koni amɛdara daa. Eteɔ shi ewoɔ maŋ lɛ mli kooloi ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ni ekɛ baagi babaoo baa

english: How do I choose the best cassava stems to cut when I want to expand my farm?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ mahala ŋmei tsei ni hi fe fɛɛ ni mafolɔ beni miisumɔ ni magbala miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Select stems from healthy, mature plants that are at least 8 to 18 months old, showing no signs of leaf curling or stem wounds. The middle part of the stem produces the strongest shoots.
ga: Halamɔ tsei ni yɔɔ hewalɛ, ni eda ni kɛ hoo lɛ eye nyɔji 8 kɛyashi 18, ni baai lɛ ebɔle loo tsei lɛ amli pilamɔi ahe okadi ko bɛ he lɛ ashishifãi. Tso lɛ teŋgbɛ fã lɛ ji nɔ ni woɔ ŋmeii ni he wa fe fɛɛ.

english: How can I tell if my farm soil is tired and needs extra manure or fertilizer?
ga: Te mafee tɛŋŋ male kɛji shikpɔŋ ni yɔɔ miŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ efite ni ehe miihia ni akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii loo ŋmɔshi nibii babaoo awo mli?

english: If your crop leaves look pale green or yellow instead of deep green, or if crops stay short and take too long to grow, the soil has lost its nutrients and needs organic manure or fertilizer.
ga: Kɛji otso lɛ baai lɛ tamɔ eŋɔli loo ŋmɔŋ yɛ eŋɔli ni mli edɔ najiaŋ. aloo kɛji tso lɛ hiɔ shi be kukuoo ni ekɛ be babaoo tsuɔ nii dani edaa Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ nibii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ efo mli ni ehe miihia humus loo organic fertilizer.

english: Why do my harvested yams start rotting so quickly after I stack them in my barn?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-sweet potatoes ni mikpa lɛ bɔi fitemɔ oya nɛkɛ beni mito amɛ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Yams rot quickly if they were bruised during harvesting or if the storage barn is hot and lacks airflow. Storing wounded yams separately and hanging the good ones on raised wooden racks in a cool shade keeps them fresh.
ga: Sweet potatoes lɛ fiteɔ oya kɛji akɛ amɛhe tsɔ yɛ kpamɔ be mli loo kɛji akɛ he ni akɛtoɔ lɛ mli edɔ ni kɔɔyɔɔ bɛ mli. Kɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni epila lɛ ato he kroko ni okɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ awo tso shɛlɛf ni awo nɔ lɛ nɔ yɛ he ko ni mli ejɔ ni hulutsoo yɔɔ koni amɛhi shi ehee.

english: Why are the leaves on my young cocoa plants turning brown and burning?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ baai ni yɔɔ mi cacao tsei bibii lɛ anɔ lɛ miitsɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni amɛmiishã lɛ?

english: Young cocoa plants need shade to protect them from direct sunlight. Without temporary shade crops like plantain or cassava nearby, the harsh sun scorches their leaves, drying them out and slowing down growth.
ga: Kakao tsei bibii lɛ biɔ hulutsoo be koni amɛbu amɛhe kɛjɛ hulu la ni tsoɔ tɛ̃ɛ lɛ he. Kɛji akɛ be kukuoo mli hulutsoo tsei tamɔ plantains loo cassava bɛ ni bɛŋkɛ Hulu ni tsoɔ waa lɛ baashã baai lɛ. ni ehaa dalɛ baa shi

english: Having too many shoots around one plantain tree forces them to compete for water and soil nutrients. Leaving only two or three strong shoots ensures the main tree gets enough food to produce large bunches.
ga: Ni aaaná dumɔwui babaoo ni ebɔle amɛhe Dumɔwu kome pɛ nyɛɔ amɛnɔ koni amɛye akaŋ koni amɛná niyenii ni jɛɔ nu kɛ shikpɔŋ mli. Kɛ́ ashi niji enyɔ loo etɛ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ pɛ lɛ, ebaaha tso titri lɛ aná niyenii ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛbaakwɛ niji wuji.

english: Why are the leaves of my maize plants turning yellow starting from the tips?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmãa tsei ahe baai lɛ feɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛjɛɔ amɛshishigbɛ lɛ?

english: When maize leaves turn yellow in a shape that starts at the tip and moves down the center, it usually means the soil lacks nitrogen. Applying a nitrogen-rich fertilizer helps the leaves turn green and healthy again.
ga: Kɛji akɛ ŋmãa baai lɛ tsɔ ŋmɔŋ kɛjɛ amɛshishigbɛ ni amɛyaa shi kɛyaa teŋgbɛ lɛ Bei pii lɛ Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni baai lɛ afee ŋmɔji ni amɛhe wa ekoŋŋ.

english: What causes small ragged holes in my young maize leaves with tiny caterpillars inside?
ga: Mɛni kɛ buji bibii lɛ baa? Yɛ mi gbekɛ lɛ mli lɛ, ŋmeii bibii yɛ mli.

english: This damage is caused by the Fall Armyworm, a common pest that feeds on maize leaves and stems. Catching them early and spraying recommended pesticides or neem extract helps protect the crop.
ga: Nɔ ni kɛ nɛkɛ fitemɔ nɛɛ baa ji Fall Armyworm, ni ji tsɛŋemɔ hela ko ni afɔɔ namɔ ni yeɔ ŋmãa baai kɛ ŋmãa shishifãi lɛ. Ni ooomɔ amɛ mra Ni okɛ tsofa ni gbeɔ kooloi loo neem mli nu ni atsɔɔ akɛ akɛtsu nii lɛ afɔ nɔ lɛ baaye abua ni abu ŋmɔshi nibii lɛ ahe.

english: Why do my cassava roots rot in the ground when there is a lot of rain?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ ŋmeii shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava roots rot in waterlogged soil because excess water stops air from reaching the roots, allowing fungus to grow. Planting cassava on raised mounds or ridges helps excess rainwater drain away.
ga: Cassava shishifãi lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ haaa kɔɔyɔɔ ayashɛ shishifãi lɛ ahe. Ehaa ŋmeii daa. Kasava ni aduɔ yɛ gɔji ni nɔ kwɔlɔ loo ŋshɔkei lɛ anɔ lɛ haa nugbɔ nu ni fa fe nine lɛ hoɔ kɛyaa.

english: Yam vines need to climb high on sticks so their leaves can trap direct sunlight. More sunlight helps the leaves produce energy, which makes the yam tubers under the ground grow much bigger.
ga: Ehe miihia ni sweet potato wain tsei lɛ akwɔ kɛya ŋwɛi shɔɔŋ yɛ tsei lɛ aniji lɛ anɔ bɔni afee ni amɛbaai lɛ anyɛ ashɛ hulu la lɛ he tɛ̃ɛ. Hulu la babaoo yeɔ ebuaa baai lɛ ni amɛnáa hewalɛ. Enɛ haa ŋmeii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ shishi lɛ daraa babaoo.

english: Leaf curl in pepper plants is usually caused by tiny insects like whiteflies or thrips sucking the plant juices. Controlling these pests early prevents the leaves from curling and keeps the plant growing well.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, kooloi bibii tamɔ whiteflies loo thrips ni nuɔ tsei amli nu lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baai ni ebɔle ehe lɛ baa. Nɛkɛ tsɛŋemɔ helai nɛɛ anɔyeli mra Enɛ baatsi baai lɛ anaa koni ekafee ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni eye ebua tso lɛ ni eda jogbaŋŋ.

english: Why do my tomato flowers fall off before any tomatoes start to grow?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-tomato fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi dani tomato lɛ jeɔ shishi ekwɛ̃ɔ lɛ?

english: Tomato flowers often fall off due to high heat, lack of water, or poor soil nutrients. Keeping the soil evenly moist and protecting plants during very hot days helps the flowers stay on and form fruit.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, tomato fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi yɛ dɔlɛ ni naa wa, nu ni bɛ, loo shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ niyenii kpakpai ahewɔ. Shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ni ahiɔ shi daa kɛ tsei ahe ni abuɔ yɛ gbii ni mli edɔ lɛ amli lɛ baaye abua ni fɔfɔi lɛ ahi shi ni amɛwo yibii.

english: Why is it good for me to plant groundnuts together with my maize?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ esa akɛ mikɛ mi-ŋmãa lɛ adu ŋmãa?

english: Groundnuts are legumes that naturally add nitrogen food back into the soil from the air. This enriches the soil and helps the maize grow stronger without needing as much chemical fertilizer.
ga: Peanuts ji ŋmeii ni kɛ nitrogen ni jɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ mli lɛ kuɔ esɛɛ kɛyaa shikpɔŋ lɛ mli yɛ adebɔɔ naa. Enɛ haa shikpɔŋ lɛ feɔ ŋmɔshi nii ni eyeɔ ebuaa ni ŋmãa lɛ daa waa ni ehe ehiaaa ni akɛ tsofai babaoo awo mli tamɔ nɛkɛ.

english: Why does clearing weeds while my crops are still small help them yield better?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ jwɛi ni mijieɔ yɛ be mli ni miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ faaa lolo lɛ haa yibiiwoo yaa hiɛ lɛ?

english: Weeds steal water, sunlight, and soil nutrients away from young crops. Clearing them early ensures your crops get all the food and light they need to establish strong roots and grow fast.
ga: Jwɛi juɔ nu, hulu la, kɛ sũ mli niyenii kɛjɛɔ tsei bibii amli. Amɛjiemɔ mra Ebaaha onibii lɛ niyenii kɛ la ni he hiaa amɛ koni amɛná shishifãi ni wa ni amɛdara oya.

english: Yellow leaves on young maize usually mean the plants lack nitrogen or that excess water around the roots is suffocating them. Adding nitrogen fertilizer like urea or improving field drainage will help them turn green and grow strong.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baai ni yɔɔ ŋmɔŋ ni yɔɔ ŋmãa bibii anɔ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ tso lɛ mli loo nu babaoo yɛ ehe. suffocating roots Kɛ́ akɛ nitrogen ŋmɔshi nibii tamɔ urea fata he loo nu ni hoɔ yɛ ŋmɔ lɛ mli lɛ baaha amɛfee ŋmɔji ni amɛdara waa.

english: Cocoa flowers drop when the tree is stressed by dry weather, lack of nutrients, or attacks from insects like mirids. Providing adequate shade trees and managing insect pests early helps the flowers stay on and form pods.
ga: Cocoa fɔfɔi lɛ shwieɔ shi kɛ́ kɔɔyɔŋ ni mli egbi, niyenii ni haa mɔ hewalɛ ni bɛ, loo kooloi bibii tamɔ pollen lɛ ha tso lɛ hao. Ni akɛ hulutsoo be ni sa baaha kɛ mra be mli nibii ni yeɔ mɔ awui lɛ ahe nitsumɔ Enɛ yeɔ ebuaa fɔfɔi lɛ ni amɛhiɔ shi ni amɛfeɔ ŋmeii.

english: Why do my cassava stem cuttings rot in the ground when I plant them during heavy rains?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cassava tsei lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli kɛ́ adu yɛ nugbɔ ni nɛɔ waa lɛ mli lɛ?

english: Cassava stem cuttings rot in waterlogged soil because standing water cuts off oxygen to the stem. Planting cuttings on raised mounds or ridges allows excess water to drain away so roots can form safely.
ga: Kasava tsei ni afoɔ lɛ fiteɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ ni nu eyi mli obɔ lɛ nɔ ejaakɛ nu ni ekã shi lɛ ŋmɛɔ kɔɔyɔɔ ni haa wala yibii lɛ yaa lɛ. Kɛ́ adu tsei ni afo yɛ gɔŋ loo ŋshɔkpɔ ko ni nɔ kwɔ nɔ lɛ, ebaaha nu ni fa fe nine lɛ atsɔ mli. koni shishifãi lɛ anyɛ ada shweshweeshwe

english: Why does my maize grow tall and thin with small cobs when I plant seeds close together?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-abele lɛ kɛlɛ ni eyɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ ni eyɛ ŋmeii bibii lɛ? Mɛɛ be esa akɛ adu dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe?

english: When maize seeds are planted too close together, the plants compete with each other for sunlight, water, and soil nutrients. Proper spacing gives each plant enough space to develop thick stems and large cobs.
ga: Kɛji adu ŋmãa dumɔwui ni bɛŋkɛ amɛhe tsɔ Tsei kɛ amɛhe woɔ hulu la, nu kɛ niyenii ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ he akaŋ. Gbɛ ni sa ni akɛtoɔ tso lɛ he lɛ haa tso fɛɛ tso naa gbɛ ni fa bɔ ni sa ni ekɛwoɔ tso lɛ mli tsei ni mli tse kɛ ŋmeii wuji.

english: Yam tubers grow crooked or small when the soil is hard, stony, or shallow. Clearing stones and making high, soft mounds of loose earth allows the tubers to expand downward easily.
ga: Sweet potato ŋmeii lɛ feɔ ŋmeii loo bibii kɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ mli wa. Ani tɛi yɛ jɛmɛ loo amɛhe ekɔɔɔ? Tɛi ni ajieɔ kɛ shikpɔŋ ni nɔ kwɔ ni yɔɔ blɛoo ni afee lɛ haa ŋmeii lɛ shwereɔ kɛyaa shishi oya.

english: Why are the leaves of my tomato plants curling up and stopping the fruits from growing?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi tomato baai lɛ miihoso ni amɛmiikpa aduawai lɛ adalɛ?

english: Leaf curling in tomatoes is often caused by heat stress or tiny insects like whiteflies spreading a plant virus. Keeping the soil cool with mulch and managing sap-feeding insects early helps prevent leaf curl.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, hulutsoo loo kooloi bibii tamɔ whiteflies ni gbɛɔ helai ni baa tsei amli lɛ ji nɔ ni kɛ baa ni shwieɔ shi yɛ tomato mli lɛ baa. Ha shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ afee fɛ̃i kɛtsɔ ŋmɔshi nibii kɛ kooloi ni yeɔ kooloi lɛ anɔkwɛmɔ mra. Eyeɔ ebuaa ni ehaa baai lɛ shwieɔ shi.

english: Why do my pepper plants drop their green fruits before they ripen?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-pepper tso lɛ miiho aduawai eŋɔli dani amɛshwere lɛ?

english: Pepper plants drop young fruit when soil water levels change suddenly from very dry to very wet, or during extreme heat. Watering regularly and spreading dry grass mulch around the plants keeps soil moisture steady.
ga: Pepper tsei lɛ shwieɔ amɛyibii bibii lɛ ashwieɔ shi kɛ́ nu ni yɔɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ tsake trukaa kɛjɛ shikpɔŋ ni egbi waa kɛtee shikpɔŋ ni edɔ waa nɔ. loo yɛ be mli ni hulutsoo be lɛ mli wa waa lɛ Nu daa ni okɛ ŋmɔtɔ ni egbi aha tso lɛ nɔ koni shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ ŋmɔtɔ ahi shi daa.

english: Why do holes appear on my cabbage leaves right before the heads start forming?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ buji miije kpo yɛ mi-cabbage baai lɛ anɔ dani yitsei jeɔ shishi efeɔ lɛ?

english: Holes in cabbage leaves are caused by caterpillars, such as the diamondback moth larvae, eating the foliage. Checking under leaves regularly and applying recommended organic or chemical sprays protects the growing heads.
ga: Buji ni yɔɔ kaabɛji baai amli lɛ jɛɔ ŋmeii, tamɔ diamondback moth larvae, ni yeɔ baai lɛ amli. Kɛ́ okwɛ baai lɛ ashishi be fɛɛ be ni okɛ tsofai ni akɛwoɔ mli loo tsofai ni akɛwoɔ mli lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni ebu ŋmeii ni miida lɛ ahe.

english: Why do my cowpea plants grow lots of green leaves but produce very few bean pods?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ mi-cowpea tso lɛ yɛ baai eŋɔli babaoo shi ŋmeii fioo pɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ?

english: Too much nitrogen in the soil causes cowpeas to put all their energy into growing leaves instead of flowers and pods. Using balanced fertilizers rich in phosphorus encourages strong flowering and heavy pod production.
ga: Nitrogen ni fa babaoo yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli lɛ haa cowpea kɛ ehewalɛ fɛɛ tsuɔ nii ni ekɛwoɔ baai yɛ fɔfɔi kɛ ŋmeii najiaŋ. Kɛ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni ja ni phosphorus babaoo yɔɔ mli lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaha fɔfɔi ni mli wa kɛ podi ni tsii aba.

english: Yellowing leaf tips usually mean your maize lacks nitrogen, which is the main nutrient plants need to grow green and leafy. Applying a nitrogen-rich fertilizer or well-rotted animal manure around the plant will help restore its green color and health.
ga: Bei pii lɛ, baa ni ji ŋmɔŋ lɛ tsɔɔ akɛ nitrogen bɛ o-corn lɛ mli. Nɔ ni ji niyenii titri ni he hiaa tsei koni amɛkwɛ̃ ni amɛná baai. Kɛ akɛ ŋmɔshi nibii ni nitrogen babaoo yɔɔ mli loo kooloi ashishifãi ni fiteɔ ni bɔle tso lɛ he lɛ tsu nii lɛ, ebaaye ebua ni eha ehiɛ su ni ji eŋɔli kɛ hewalɛ ekoŋŋ.

english: Why do my crops yield less every year if I plant maize on the exact same plot without a break?
ga: Mɛni hewɔ miŋmɔshi nibii lɛ woɔ yibii fioo daa afi kɛji midu ŋmãa yɛ ŋmɔ kome mli yɛ be kɛ bei amli lɛ?

english: Planting the same crop continuously drains the exact same nutrients from the soil every season and lets specific pests build up in the ground. Rotating maize with legumes like groundnuts or cowpeas returns nitrogen to the soil and keeps it fertile.
ga: Nibii ni aduɔ yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ lɛ nɔŋŋ be fɛɛ be lɛ haa niyenii mli hewalɛ kome lɛ nɔŋŋ hoɔ kɛjɛɔ shikpɔŋ lɛ mli daa be, ni ehaa tsɛŋemɔ helai komɛi buaa amɛhe naa yɛ shikpɔŋ lɛ nɔ. Kɛ́ akɛ ŋmãa ni akɛ ŋmãa tamɔ ŋmãa loo tsina ŋmãa tsake lɛ, ebaaha nitrogen aku sɛɛ aba shikpɔŋ lɛ mli ni eye ebua ni ekɛ ŋmãa aba.

english: Young cocoa plants are delicate and cannot handle direct, harsh sunlight. Leaving large shade trees or planting temporary shade crops like plantains protects the young cocoa leaves from scorching heat and keeps moisture in the soil until the trees mature.
ga: Cacao tsei bibii lɛ ahe waaa ni amɛnyɛŋ amɛŋmɛ hulu la ni naa wa waa lɛ gbɛ.
